name: Weather & AQI
summary: Weather and India's AQI (CPCB scale) in the island: tile, optional always-on temperature, rain-soon and poor-air alerts.

permissions.name: android.permission.INTERNET
permissions.reason: Fetches weather and air quality from Open-Meteo for the saved place

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
permissions.reason: Optional: approximate current location, only while the Weather screen is open

privacy: Sends only the place, rounded to about 1 km, to Open-Meteo, with no account or ID. Never uses location in the background.
